data.name: StepHelp_Type
data.value: Choose what the job does. Each type corresponds to one 4.x job. Name and group identify the job in lists, logs and the history (Group.Name).

data.name: StepHelp_D365
data.value: Which D365 environment and which data project or recurring integration the job uses. Use "Test connection" to check authentication and permissions from the server.

data.name: StepHelp_Files
data.value: Folders are read and written by the SERVICE ACCOUNT, not by you. Network shares (\\server\share) need a domain account or gMSA. Use "Check access" next to a folder.

data.name: StepHelp_Schedule
data.value: When the job runs. Times are in the selected time zone. The rhythm does not move after a service restart.

data.name: StepHelp_Advanced
data.value: Defaults work for most jobs. Change only when needed: waiting for D365, retries, behaviour after errors, custom OData actions.

data.name: StepHelp_Summary
data.value: Check the description and the next runs. Saving validates the whole configuration (e.g. that the connection exists) and the job is scheduled at once.

data.name: JobTypeHelp_Export
data.value: Starts an export of a data project in D365, waits until it finishes and downloads the package to a folder (optionally unzipped, timestamped, sent to SFTP).

data.name: JobTypeHelp_Import
data.value: Takes files from a folder (or SFTP), wraps them into a data package if needed and imports them into a data project. Pair it with an execution monitor to see the result in D365.

data.name: JobTypeHelp_Upload
data.value: Sends files from a folder to a recurring integration (enqueue). Pair it with a processing monitor to see whether D365 processed the message.

data.name: JobTypeHelp_Download
data.value: Takes messages of a recurring integration from D365 (dequeue), saves each package to a folder and acknowledges it.

data.name: JobTypeHelp_ExecutionMonitor
data.value: Checks imports started by an import job (status files) and moves the files to processed or errors, with error details from D365.

data.name: JobTypeHelp_ProcessingMonitor
data.value: Checks messages sent by an upload job and moves the files to processed or errors when D365 has processed them.

data.name: JobTypeFlow_Export
data.value: D365 export → package → folder [→ unzip] [→ SFTP]

data.name: JobTypeFlow_Import
data.value: [SFTP →] folder → package → D365 import → status file

data.name: JobTypeFlow_Upload
data.value: [SFTP →] folder → enqueue to D365 → status file

data.name: JobTypeFlow_Download
data.value: D365 dequeue → package → folder [→ unzip] [→ SFTP] → ack

data.name: JobTypeFlow_ExecutionMonitor
data.value: status file → D365 execution status → processed / errors

data.name: JobTypeFlow_ProcessingMonitor
data.value: status file → D365 message status → processed / errors

data.name: Wizard_CreateMonitor
data.value: Also create the monitor job for this job

data.name: Wizard_MonitorHint
data.value: Creates "{0}" with the same folders, running every 5 minutes, linked as the paired job.

data.name: Wizard_CopyHint
data.value: Copies all settings; change the name before saving.

data.name: Wizard_FixProblems
data.value: Fix the problems of this step to continue.

data.name: Wizard_HelpClick
data.value: Click ⓘ next to a field for details.

data.name: Wizard_NoFields
data.value: Nothing to set in this step for this job type.

data.name: Sched_EveryHint
data.value: The rhythm is counted from this time, e.g. every 2 hours from 12:00 = 00:00, 02:00 … 12:00, 14:00. A restart does not shift it.

data.name: Sched_CronHint
data.value: Quartz cron: seconds minutes hours day-of-month month day-of-week. Examples: 0 0 2 * * ? = daily 02:00; 0 0/15 * * * ? = every 15 minutes; 0 0 6 ? * MON-FRI = weekdays 06:00; 0 0 8-18 ? * MON-FRI = every hour 8–18 on weekdays.

data.name: Sched_MissedHelp
data.value: Run once after start: if the service was stopped at a planned time, the job runs once right after the start (recommended for exports). Skip: it waits for the next planned time.

data.name: Sched_PausedHelp
data.value: The job is saved and visible but does not run until resumed.

data.name: FieldHint_Connection
data.value: D365 environment and app registration (Connections page)

data.name: FieldHelp_Connection
data.value: Connection to the D365 environment: AOS URL, Entra ID tenant, client id and secret or certificate. Defined once on the Connections page and shared by jobs.

data.name: FieldHint_DataProject
data.value: Name of the data project in D365 Data management

data.name: FieldHelp_DataProject
data.value: Data project (definition group) in D365 → Data management. Export: the project to export. Import: the project the package is imported into. Must exist in the environment.

data.name: FieldHint_ActivityId
data.value: Id of the recurring data job (GUID)

data.name: FieldHelp_ActivityId
data.value: D365 → Data management → Recurring data jobs → the job's ID (activity id), e.g. 6F1B3C2A-…

data.name: FieldHint_EntityName
data.value: Target entity when the files are not data packages

data.name: FieldHelp_EntityName
data.value: Data entity name as shown in D365 (e.g. "Customers V3"). Needed only when the uploaded files are plain files, not data packages.

data.name: FieldHint_IsDataPackage
data.value: Files are data packages (zip with Manifest.xml)

data.name: FieldHelp_IsDataPackage
data.value: On: each file is a complete data package. Off: each file is a single entity file and Entity name is used.

data.name: FieldHelp_Company
data.value: D365 legal entity (company) code. For a multi-company import leave empty and set Multi-company.

data.name: FieldHint_InputFilesArePackages
data.value: Files in the input folder are ready data packages

data.name: FieldHelp_InputFilesArePackages
data.value: On: each input file is a zip data package imported as is. Off: each file is wrapped into the package template.

data.name: FieldHint_PackageTemplate
data.value: Zip exported from D365 with Manifest.xml

data.name: FieldHelp_PackageTemplate
data.value: Path to a data package template: export the data project once from D365 and keep the zip. RIS replaces the data file in it with each input file.

data.name: FieldHint_OverwriteDataProject
data.value: Needed when the data project already exists in D365

data.name: FieldHelp_OverwriteDataProject
data.value: Passed to ImportFromPackage. D365 rejects the import of a package into a data project that already exists unless this is on ("The data project … exists and overwrite has not been specified"); the project definition is then replaced by the manifest of the package. Usually on.

data.name: FieldHint_ExecuteImport
data.value: Run the import right away (otherwise only staging)

data.name: FieldHelp_ExecuteImport
data.value: On: data goes to the target tables. Off: data stays in staging and the import is finished in D365.

data.name: FieldHint_GetExecutionErrors
data.value: Save D365 execution errors next to failed files

data.name: FieldHelp_GetExecutionErrors
data.value: For failed imports the execution errors are downloaded from D365 and saved as a text file next to the file in the errors folder.

data.name: FieldHint_GetImportTargetErrorKeysFile
data.value: Save error keys per entity for failed imports

data.name: FieldHelp_GetImportTargetErrorKeysFile
data.value: Generates and downloads the error keys file of each entity (the records that failed), next to the file in the errors folder.

data.name: FieldHint_MultiCompany
data.value: Legal entity taken from the subfolder or the file name

data.name: FieldHelp_MultiCompany
data.value: One import job for many legal entities: the company is the name of the subfolder of the input folder, or a part of the file name (separator and position, e.g. "_" and 2 for ORDERS_USMF_001.csv).

data.name: FieldHelp_InputDir
data.value: Files matching the file mask are taken from this folder (also from subfolders; the structure is kept in the target folders).

data.name: FieldHint_Files
data.value: Which files and in which order

data.name: FieldHelp_Files
data.value: File mask (e.g. *.csv, *.zip) and the order of processing. Order matters when files depend on each other (e.g. headers before lines).

data.name: FieldHint_UploadSuccessDir
data.value: Files sent to D365 are moved here

data.name: FieldHelp_UploadSuccessDir
data.value: After a successful upload/import request the file is moved here, together with its status file for the monitor.

data.name: FieldHint_UploadErrorsDir
data.value: Files that could not be sent

data.name: FieldHelp_UploadErrorsDir
data.value: Files rejected by D365 are moved here with an error report (code, message, D365 response).

data.name: FieldHelp_DownloadSuccessDir
data.value: Target folder of exported or dequeued packages. File names follow the file name pattern.

data.name: FieldHint_DownloadErrorsDir
data.value: Packages that could not be processed

data.name: FieldHelp_DownloadErrorsDir
data.value: Packages that failed after download (e.g. unzip or acknowledgement) are moved here.

data.name: FieldHelp_ProcessingSuccessDir
data.value: The monitor moves files here when D365 reports success.

data.name: FieldHint_ProcessingErrorsDir
data.value: Files that failed in D365, with error details

data.name: FieldHelp_ProcessingErrorsDir
data.value: The monitor moves files here when D365 reports an error or the timeout passes, together with error keys / execution errors and a link to D365.

data.name: FieldHelp_UnzipPackage
data.value: The content of the package is extracted into the folder (a subfolder per package).

data.name: FieldHint_AddTimestamp
data.value: Add date and time to extracted files

data.name: FieldHelp_AddTimestamp
data.value: Extracted files get a timestamp in their names so later runs do not overwrite them.

data.name: FieldHelp_DeletePackage
data.value: Only the extracted files are kept.

data.name: FieldHint_WriteStatusFiles
data.value: Needed when a monitor job checks this job

data.name: FieldHelp_WriteStatusFiles
data.value: A small status file (execution or message id) is written next to each sent file; the monitor job reads it.

data.name: FieldHint_StatusFileExtension
data.value: e.g. .Status – the same in the job and its monitor

data.name: FieldHelp_StatusFileExtension
data.value: Extension of the status files. The job and its monitor must use the same one.

data.name: FieldHint_SftpInbound
data.value: Download the input files from SFTP first

data.name: FieldHelp_SftpInbound
data.value: Before processing, files matching the mask are downloaded from the SFTP server folder into the input folder.

data.name: FieldHint_SftpOutbound
data.value: Also upload the packages to SFTP

data.name: FieldHelp_SftpOutbound
data.value: After saving, each package is uploaded to the SFTP server folder.

data.name: FieldHelp_Polling
data.value: Status checks start after Initial delay, the delay grows by Growth factor up to Maximum delay. After Timeout (default 12 h) the run fails with RIS-EXP-001 / RIS-MON-001. 4.x: 100 attempts.

data.name: FieldHint_Retry
data.value: Repeat failed requests and file operations

data.name: FieldHelp_Retry
data.value: Temporary problems (timeouts, throttling, 5xx, locked files) are retried Count times with Delay between attempts. Starting an export or import is never repeated (risk of duplicates).

data.name: FieldHelp_DelayBetweenFiles
data.value: Waits this long after each file, e.g. to spread the load on D365. 0 = no pause.

data.name: FieldHint_ErrorKeysFileTimeout
data.value: How long to wait for the error keys file

data.name: FieldHelp_ErrorKeysFileTimeout
data.value: D365 generates the error keys file asynchronously; after this time the file is skipped with a warning.

data.name: FieldHint_PauseOnError
data.value: Pause the job after a failed run

data.name: FieldHelp_PauseOnError
data.value: The job stops running after a failure until someone resumes it. Useful when a repeated run could do harm.

data.name: FieldHint_IndefinitePause
data.value: Keep the job but never run it

data.name: FieldHelp_IndefinitePause
data.value: The definition is kept (e.g. for later) but the job never runs, not even by "Run now". 4.x: IndefinitePause.

data.name: FieldHelp_ActionPaths
data.value: Paths of the D365 Data management OData actions. Change only when your environment uses custom actions.

data.name: FieldHint_Envelope
data.value: How a data file becomes a D365 data package

data.name: FieldHelp_Envelope
data.value: Generated (recommended): Manifest.xml and PackageHeader.xml are created from the entities of the data project read from D365 – no template file. A single file goes to the only entity of the project; a zip with data files of several entities (named after the entities, e.g. "Customer groups.csv") becomes one package; a zip that already contains Manifest.xml is imported as it is. Columns are mapped by name. Template: copy of the package template (as in 4.x) – needed for own mapping, transformations or default values in D365.

data.name: FieldHint_AllowPartialPackages
data.value: Import a package even if files of some entities are missing

data.name: FieldHelp_AllowPartialPackages
data.value: Generated envelope only. Off: a package without a file for every entity of the project goes to the errors folder. D365 itself does not report missing files – it imports the remaining entities and reports success.

data.name: Test_ProjectMissing
